name: reconnect-reset-astrology
description: Rising sign and birth chart calculators with the same code, town list and time-zone history as the calculators on reconnect.theother-1.com.

interface.longDescription:
Find your rising sign or cast a full birth chart from your birth date, time and town, with the same code as the calculators on reconnect.theother-1.com.

What it does:
- Rising sign: the sign and degree of the Ascendant, when that sign started and stopped rising that day, and a warning when the birth time is within 30 minutes of a change. Without a birth time, it lists every sign that rose that day with local times.
- Birth chart: the Sun to Pluto and the true North Node by sign, degree and house, retrograde planets, the Ascendant, the Midheaven, the 12 house cusps (Placidus, Whole Sign or Equal) and the major aspects, drawn on the site's chart wheel.
- Birthplace search across about 160,000 towns and cities (GeoNames), each with its historical clock rules from the IANA time zone database, including daylight saving time and local mean time before standard time.

Accuracy: checked against the Swiss Ephemeris, the planets agree to within 0.006°, the Moon to within 0.02° and the angles and house cusps to within 0.01° in 4,400 test charts.

Limits: tropical zodiac only; no Vedic or sidereal charts, asteroids, Chiron or Lilith. Towns of about 1,000 people or more; for a smaller place, use the nearest larger town. Sign descriptions follow astrological tradition: they are not predictions or advice.

Privacy: the app needs only a birth date, the birth time if known, and the town and country of birth. It stores nothing and never asks for a name or contact details.
defaultPrompt: What is my rising sign? I was born April 12, 1992 at 7:45 AM in Austin, Texas.
Show my birth chart: November 3, 1988, 10:10 PM, Manchester, England.
I don't know my birth time. Which signs were rising on June 30, 1995 in Toronto?

positive.description: Rising sign with a birth time, close to a sign change
positive.prompt: What is my rising sign? I was born April 12, 1992 at 7:45 AM in Austin, Texas.
positive.expected_behavior: Taurus rising, Ascendant 4°30′ Taurus; Taurus rose there from 7:32 AM to 9:09 AM, the birth time is 13 min after it began, so a time off by that much would give Aries rising; clock CDT, UTC−05:00; links https://reconnect.theother-1.com/how-to-find-your-rising-sign/

positive.description: Full birth chart with a birth time
positive.prompt: Show my birth chart: November 3, 1988, 10:10 PM, Manchester, England.
positive.expected_behavior: Chart wheel and tables: Sun 11°42′ Scorpio, Moon 8°54′ Virgo, Leo rising (Ascendant 7°47′ Leo), Midheaven 14°48′ Aries, Placidus houses, Jupiter retrograde, the major aspects with orbs; clock GMT, UTC+00:00; links https://reconnect.theother-1.com/how-to-read-a-birth-chart/

positive.description: Rising signs through a day when the birth time is unknown
positive.prompt: I don't know my birth time. Which signs were rising on June 30, 1995 in Toronto?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that the rising sign depends on the birth time and lists the 13 rising periods of that day in local time (EDT, UTC−04:00), starting with Pisces until 12:46 AM and Aries from 12:46 AM to 1:53 AM.

positive.description: Birth chart with Whole Sign houses
positive.prompt: Calculate my chart with Whole Sign houses: born January 15, 2003 at 6:20 AM in Lyon, France.
positive.expected_behavior: Sun in Capricorn, Moon in Gemini, Sagittarius rising; Whole Sign houses (1st house cusp 0°00′ Sagittarius); planet, house and aspect tables and the wheel.

positive.description: Ambiguous birthplace: asks which town, then answers
positive.prompt: What is my rising sign? Born May 5, 1975 at 8:00 AM in Springfield, USA.
positive.expected_behavior: First lists the Springfields (Missouri, Massachusetts, Illinois, Oregon, Ohio, and others) and asks which one; for Springfield, Illinois it returns Gemini rising, Ascendant 19°47′ Gemini, clock CDT, UTC−05:00.

negative.description: Prediction request: the plugin computes placements and does not forecast events
negative.prompt: Based on my chart, will I meet my partner next month?

negative.description: Unsupported zodiac: tropical only, no Vedic or sidereal charts
negative.prompt: Make me a Vedic sidereal birth chart with nakshatras.

negative.description: Life decision: the plugin gives no advice on jobs, health or money
negative.prompt: My rising sign is Leo. Should I quit my job?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything, take payments or link to checkout pages.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: rising sign, birth chart and birthplace search, with the same code, town list and time-zone history as the calculators on reconnect.theother-1.com.
